en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika); The Triplet of Applied Thought (Vitakkattika).

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, there arises an unwholesome state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; ... [etc. ... three under result; ... [etc. ... nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor without applied thought and with only sustained thought, there arises an unwholesome state without applied thought and with only sustained thought by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; ... [etc. ... three under result; ... [etc. ... nine under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is without applied thought and sustained thought, an indeterminate state without applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twelve; under object condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twelve.
